facts.fact: Levellers says Loi No 1/03 du 10 mars 2026 on personal data protection is Burundi's main AI-relevant hard law; no commencement date is given.
Levellers says the law creates a Personal Data Protection Agency in law but leaves its missions and organisation to a later decree, and no operational authority was identified.
Levellers says the data protection law dated 10 March 2026 is now Burundi's main AI-relevant hard law.
